## Business Model & Supply Terms
- **Business Type:** Direct Container Importer, Mandi Wholesaler, Bulk Distributor (B2B only)
- **Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ):** Starts from 15kg (supplied exclusively in commercial master packaging).
- **Retail Policy:** Single retail consumer units are NOT sold. All products are supplied strictly in sealed master cartons and sacks.
- **Port of Entry:** Direct container import from California (USA) and Iran through Nhava Sheva (JNPT) port.
- **Delivery Coverage:** Dispatched across 23 Indian states with cold-chain and dry freight logistics.
- **Pricing:** Wholesale APMC mandi rates exclusive of statutory GST (5% or 12% itemized on tax invoices).
